title: Trim Trailing Whitespace
summary: A Claude Code hook that removes spaces and tabs at the end of lines in each file the agent edits, keeping diffs free of invisible changes.
description: Invisible trailing spaces create noisy diffs and fail some linters. After every Edit or Write this PostToolUse hook rewrites the file with those spaces and tabs removed from each line.
Windows line endings stay as they are. Markdown, diff and patch files are skipped because trailing spaces can carry meaning there, and files with null bytes are left alone.
useWhen: Keep whitespace noise out of pull requests
Work in a repo without an editorconfig plugin
Satisfy linters that reject trailing spaces

hook.command: node -e "process.on('uncaughtException',()=>process.exit(0));let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)||{}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const f=String(i.file_path||'');const fs=require('fs');const rd=()=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')}catch(e){return null}};const e=require('path').extname(f).toLowerCase();if(['.md','.markdown','.mdx','.diff','.patch'].includes(e))process.exit(0);const t=rd();if(t===null||t.includes(String.fromCharCode(0)))process.exit(0);const o=t.split('\n').map(l=>{const cr=l.endsWith('\r');let b=cr?l.slice(0,-1):l;while(b.endsWith(' ')||b.endsWith('\t'))b=b.slice(0,-1);return cr?b+'\r':b}).join('\n');if(o!==t)fs.writeFileSync(f,o);process.exit(0)})"

example.prompt: Add a retry loop to fetchUser in api.js.
example.result: The new lines had two stray spaces. The hook strips them and the saved file shows a clean diff.

faq.question: Why are Markdown files skipped?
faq.answer: Two trailing spaces mark a hard line break in Markdown, so removing them could change how the page renders.

faq.question: Will it touch lines I did not edit?
faq.answer: It cleans the whole file, so old trailing spaces elsewhere in that file disappear too.

access: Rewrites that file only when trailing whitespace was found
